beaches.name: Anse Source d'Argent
beaches.description: Granite boulders frame this shallow, turquoise lagoon, making it one of the most photographed beaches on Earth.

beaches.name: Navagio Beach
beaches.description: A shipwreck rests on white sand, walled in by limestone cliffs that drop straight into the Ionian Sea.

beaches.name: Whitehaven Beach
beaches.description: Seven kilometers of pure silica sand meet swirling turquoise water in the Great Barrier Reef.

temples.name: Angkor Wat
temples.description: The world's largest religious monument, built in the 12th century and still a working Buddhist temple at sunrise.

temples.name: Kinkaku-ji
temples.description: The Golden Pavilion, coated in gold leaf, reflects perfectly across its still pond garden.

temples.name: Meenakshi Amman Temple
temples.description: Fourteen painted gopuram towers, covered in thousands of carved figures, rise above the old city.

countries.name: New Zealand
countries.description: Fjords, glaciers, geothermal fields, and coastline packed into two compact islands.

countries.name: Morocco
countries.description: Sahara dunes, the Atlas Mountains, and maze-like medinas full of color and spice.

countries.name: Peru
countries.description: Home to Machu Picchu, the Amazon basin, and the high Andean altiplano.
